details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Iron-heeled kick

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Bleeding 2. **Standard defense:** Bleeding 1.

### Shoulder Through

*It lowers its weight and makes the space in front of it suddenly too small.*

Push one adjacent creature 1 square. Apply Stability and normal collision rules. Once per turn; no separate damage.

### Break the Approach

*It lashes out with shoulder or horn, spoiling the straight line of the charging foe.*

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to this creature, push that enemy 1 square directly away. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules; no separate attack damage. Forced movement and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger this.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Rush into the space where the iron boots matter, then shoulder an intruder off its claimed path. It becomes less bold when the party controls that space.

**Encounter and conversation:** It has claimed an abandoned battlefield as a garden and counts every visitor as a trespasser.

**Habitat:** Old woodland; crossroads; hidden court · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Fey 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/redcap.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-redcap


**Category:** Fey · **Role:** Attrition striker · **CV:** 22

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.404, O=4.596. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [barrel through](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/barrel-through.md), [Break the Approach](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/break-the-approach.md), [rending blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/rending-blow.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Rending Blow

*The claws snag and drag; blood follows the withdrawing talons.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-rending-blow


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard also applies Bleeding 1; Strong applies Bleeding 2. Bleeding resolves and decays at the target’s turn end. This is not a wound roll unless the ordinary Dying rule calls for one.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
